contentPattern.structure: side-by-side panels, each with decorative image + heading + text + CTA link
text-only centered panels: heading + paragraph + orange gradient CTA pill; no image

article.sectionStyle: ai-dual-cta (optional — section gradient band only; block renders without it)

suitableFor: two or more side-by-side call-to-action panels
closing dual-CTA sections with heading + text + button per panel
article: paired marketing CTAs without icons (Want to see more? / Want to test Fiix out?)
notSuitableFor: single feature/highlight (use a hero or single callout)
media/story cards with large thumbnails (use cards-video)
